## RAG – Search (reranked)
Called by the chat agent's **search_documents** tool.

1. Finds the **25 passages** closest in meaning to the question (pgvector in Supabase, same embedding model as ingestion).
2. The **local reranker** (bge-reranker-v2-m3 on this machine, port 18501) scores each passage against the question; the best **up to 4** are kept (blended with vector similarity; off-topic passages dropped). **GPT-5.4 mini** decides instead when the local reranker is down, replies badly, or keeps nothing (off-topic or borderline questions) — similar is not the same as useful (cover pages and title slides score high otherwise).
3. If GPT's reply is unusable, falls back to plain vector order, so search never fails.

Must stay **published**: the agent can only call published workflows.
